sql.query: SELECT q.id,q.recipientName,q.recipientEmail,q.subjectSnapshot,q.status,q.providerMessageId,q.queuedDate,q.sentDate,q.deliveredDate,q.failureMessage,COALESCE(u.displayName,'System') initiatedBy FROM tbl_email_queue q LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=q.initiatedByUserId WHERE q.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode IN ('email.configure','email.send') AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=q.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT 50
